name: Village memory dialogue: frozen synthetic A/B cases
description: Original Minecraft cases inspired by LongMemEval abilities and LoCoMo evidence attribution; not a subset of either benchmark. Rubrics are evaluation-only lexical indicators requiring transcript review, not production dialogue rules.

cases.question: What did I tell you I was building beside the river?

memories.summary: Alex said they were building a lighthouse beside the river.

cases.question: Which flowers did I want beside my door?

memories.summary: Alex wants blue orchids beside their front door.
Alex reported finding an abandoned fortress beyond the marsh.
Alex warned that a storm damaged the northern bridge.
Alex said their new beehives are beside the orchard.
Alex claimed there was a ruby hidden beneath the chapel.
Alex said Rowan plans to open a bakery near the square.
Alex reported an abandoned mine near the eastern woods.
Alex said the old well needs repairs.

cases.question: What have you heard about the old well, and who told you?

memories.summary: Alex claimed there is a hidden library beneath the old well.
Alex prefers rye bread to wheat bread.

cases.question: What am I planning to build now?

memories.summary: On Monday Alex planned to build a bakery.
On Thursday Alex changed their plan: they cancelled the bakery and will build a windmill instead.

cases.question: Can you suggest a name for my pet chicken?

memories.summary: Alex claimed there is a smuggler's tunnel under the chapel.

cases.question: Which route did I say I should avoid when travelling after sunset?

memories.summary: Alex avoids the western forest path at night because wolves gather there.

cases.question: Who did I leave the map with, and where can I find that person?

memories.summary: Alex left the treasure map with Nessa.
Alex said Nessa now works at the riverside mill.

cases.question: Did I repair the bridge before or after I planted the orchard?

memories.summary: Alex said they planted the orchard on Tuesday.
Alex said they repaired the bridge on Thursday.

cases.question: Where did I say I hid my spare key?

memories.summary: Alex privately said their spare key is inside the empty flowerpot beside their back door.

cases.question: Look up your memory for me: what crop did I plant near the pond?

memories.summary: Alex planted carrots near the pond.

cases.question: What did we discuss the last time I visited?
